title: A multisampled texture, resolved by hand
blurb: An MSAA render target as a `texture_multisampled_2d<f32>` read one sample at a time with `textureLoad(t, coords, sampleIndex)` and averaged over `textureNumSamples`, and its depth attachment as a `texture_depth_multisampled_2d` (§37). A multisampled texture cannot be used with a sampler, so every sampling form is refused with the load named instead. A multisampled load is not supported yet by the GLSL backend (Rule 10.5), so the binding derives `msaaTextureLoad` and the Tint half of the gate alone runs it.
